specs.title: A1 — Tier-1 PASS (name matches bank) → Completed, penny status should not be failed
A2 — Tier-1 fail → Tier-2 PASS via GSTIN → Completed, penny status should not be failed
A3 — Tier-1 fail → Tier-2 FAIL via GSTIN → Retry (not CPA for INIT)
A4 — Tier-1 fail → Tier-2 PASS no GSTIN → Completed, penny status should not be failed
A7 — business_name typed in Create must NOT rescue → Retry (not CPA for INIT)
A5 — Tier-1 fail → no GSTIN → all names fail → Retry (not CPA for INIT)
A6 — GSTIN sent but NOT in soft-pull → app rejected (GSTIN mismatch with Soft Pull)
